Title: 2018-04-16 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Tomb of the Spider Queen ===
Highlights: === Battlegrounds: Tomb of the Spider Queen ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Tomb of the Spider Queen ===
[Updates]
  • The left-side team's bottom Fort can no longer attack enemy Heroes who are just beyond the Gate.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The number of Minions Absorbed stacks no longer appear inconsistent in the Buff bar after Abathur dies while a Monstrosity is active.
  • Fixed an issue causing Spike Burst's visual effects to appear much larger than intended when cast while targeting a Mercenary with Symbiote.

=== Heroes: Alarak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Free Lightning Surge casts granted by the Lightning Barrage Talent now correctly display its cast range indicator.

=== Heroes: Ana ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Nano Boost's duration bar now appears next to, rather than replaces, any existing Ability duration bars for the targeted Ally, like Sonya's Whirlwind.

=== Heroes: Blaze ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Bunker Drop (R)
    • Players can now exit Blaze's Bunker in the direction of their choosing by right-clicking.
    • The Bunker's hitbox has been adjusted to more closely match its model. This should reduce situations in which players could unintentionally enter Blaze's bunker when clicking nearby.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Icon art has been swapped for the Adhesive Petroleum and Oil Dispersal Talents.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now correctly cast Blink Heal on Turrets and Biotic Emitters that were placed by Brightwing herself.

=== Heroes: Cassia ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Surge of Light (Active)
      • Now has a 0.25 second cooldown between uses.

=== Heroes: Cho ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Entering a Stasis effect, like Zeratul's Void Prison, while Surging Fist is charging no longer places Surging Fist on full cooldown.

=== Heroes: Deckard ===
[Releases]
  Deckard, The Last Horadrim, has been added to the Nexus and is now available for play! Read on for a brief overview of his Abilities.:
  • Fortitude of the Faithful
    • When at least 1 other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains 10 Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge 50% faster.
  • Healing Potion (Q)
    • Toss a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero that comes in contact with it for 230.
    • Limit 5 active Potions.
  • Horadric Cube (W)
    • Throw the Horadric Cube, dealing 80 damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by 40% for 1.75 seconds.
  • Scroll of Sealing (E)
    • Unfurl an enchanted scroll, forming a triangle that deals 150 damage to enemies inside and Roots them for 1.5 seconds.
  • Stay Awhile and Listen (R)
    • After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.
    • Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.
  • Lorenado (R)
    • Vector Targeting.
    • Create a swirling lorenado that travels in the targeted direction, continually knocking away any enemies that come into contact with it.

=== Heroes: Fenix ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Mobile Offensive (Passive)
      • Now grants its Basic Attack damage bonus after any movement, rather than only after unmounted movement.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Updates]
  Stats:
  • Health increased from 1550 to 1620.
  • Health Regen increased from 3.2304 to 3.3750.
  • Basic Attack damage increased from 42 to 44.
  Abilities:
  • Cyber Agility (Trait) (D)
    • Cooldown increased from 10 to 12 seconds.
  • Swift Strike (E)
    • Range reduced from 14 to 12.
  • Dragonblade (R)
    • Damage increased from 220 to 240.
    • Removed functionality:
      • Killing an enemy Hero who was recently hit by Dragonblade no longer resets Swift Strike's cooldown.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Agile Dismount (Trait)
      • Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 7 seconds.
  • Level 13
    • Double Jump (Trait)
      • No longer increases Cyber Agility's cooldown.
  • Level 20
    • The Dragon Becomes Me (R)
      • Additional Functionality:
        • Now also resets Swift Strike's cooldown if an enemy Hero dies within 2 seconds after being hit by Dragonblade.

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Partial progress earned toward the Wizened Duelist Talent's next attack damage bonus will no longer persist after dying.

=== Heroes: Gul'dan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The voiceover line that plays while idling on Gul'dan's Hero page in the Collection no longer ends early.

=== Heroes: Hanzo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause A.I. Hanzo to repeatedly Channel and cancel Storm Bow.
  • Natural Agility now activates correctly after being hit by Phase Prism near a tower.

=== Heroes: Illidan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now correctly cast Dive on Ragnaros in Molten Core form.

=== Heroes: Kel'Thuzad ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Phylactery can no longer be activated before its animation completes.

=== Heroes: Li-Ming ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Spell Armor granted by the Force Armor Talent is now correctly consumed when hit by Ability damage from non-Heroic sources.

=== Heroes: Rexxar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The tooltip for Misha, Focus! no longer lists a cooldown.
  • Switching seats in a Triglav Protector no longer causes Rexxar to become unresponsive.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Shadow Dagger (W)
    • Shadow Dagger now briefly reveals enemies upon spreading to them.

=== Heroes: The Lost Vikings ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Stealth granted by the Spy Games Talent is now correctly applied for 3 seconds after Erik moves.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Killing Minions who were hit by Chain Lightning now correctly causes Echo of the Elements quest progress visual effects to appear near Thrall, rather than allies.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue in which Uther could briefly use activated Talents after death, but prior to entering Eternal Vanguard form.
  • The Silver Touch Talent's quest rewards no longer incorrectly benefit Flash of Light.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Nydus Network (R)
    • The player can now exit Nydus Worms in a direction of their choosing by right-clicking.
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Infest Talent now correctly boosts nearby Ranged Minion damage by 100%.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • After death, Zeratul's body will no longer teleport to the location of his last Vorpal Blade target.
